contribution_types.description:
Once the initial manualscript is ready reach out to a publisher. 

The publisher will handle the publishing of the physical book as well as the publishing on Kindle. 

When new order comes through via Amazon.com for a physical book, the publisher automatically prints and ships the book.

When new order comes through via Amazon.com for onlinr version, you get paid

To crowdsource the book, first define the chapters.

Hire a bunch of ghost writers to research and write the chapters. If specific contents are interesting, prod the ghost writers to do further research in the area to write more details in.

Bulk of the effort for the main coordinator is editing
